concepts.def: Loss of gases to space; Jeans escape depends on temperature, gravity and molecular mass.
Trapping of outgoing infrared radiation by gases (CO2, H2O, CH4), raising surface temperature.
Positive-feedback warming that boiled Venus's oceans early in its history.
78% N2, 21% O2, ~1% Ar, traces of CO2, water vapour.
Magnetic shield deflecting solar wind; protects atmospheres from stripping (Mars lacks one).
Fraction of incident sunlight reflected; affects planetary energy balance and surface temperature.
